newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: A.Silva & Silva sees profit surge in '97.
newsitem.headline: A.Silva & Silva sees profit surge in '97.

text.p: Portuguese construction group A.Silva & Silva expects to quadruple net consolidated profit and boost sales by more than 20 percent in 1997 compared to 1996 with the help of an improving order book, its president said.

Jose Augusto Tavares da Silva told Reuters in an interview that he expected that the company would post a consolidated net profit of some one billion escudos and sales of between 52 and 55 billion escudos in 1997.
He said he expected 1996 profits to stand at around 250 million escudos with sales of 42 billion escudos. The group is expected to present its 1996 results between February 15 and 20.

A growing order book and improved conditions in construction explained the favourable results outlook, he added. He said he expected the order book to grow to 60 billion escudos in 1997 from 42 billion in 1996.
Tavares da Silva said the rosier outlook should enable the company to pay a higher dividend in 1997 than in 1996.
"We are expecting a dividend of 25 to 30 escudos per share for 1996," he said. "I hope we can be a little more generous in 1997."
